entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: Conflict in which the Thran Empire collapsed around -5000 AR.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Exiled Thran leader who seized power and led the Phyrexians in the war.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: Chief artificer of Halcyon whose illness led to Yawgmoth's recall; his essence became a powerstone.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Glacian's wife, who closed the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: Alliance of nations and city-states against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: Thran city-state destroyed by Yawgmoth's stonechargers.

entities.name: Orleason
entities.description: City that fell easily to the Alliance.

entities.name: Megheddon Defile
entities.description: Battle site obliterated by a stonecharger.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: Device Yawgmoth used to turn artifact creatures.

entities.name: Thran Civil War
entities.description: War before which Yawgmoth was exiled.

events.summary: Yawgmoth is exiled and commits atrocities.
events.quote: vivisecting a mighty leader to learn about the inner workings of his body

events.summary: Glacian falls ill from phthisis and Yawgmoth is recalled, becoming the most powerful person in the empire.
events.quote: Yawgmoth managed to become the most powerful person in the empire

events.summary: An alliance issues an ultimatum that Yawgmoth leave or face war.
events.quote: Either Yawgmoth would leave, or the alliance would declare war.

events.summary: After a tied vote Rebbec and Yawgmoth vote he may stay, and Yawgmoth overthrows the council.
events.quote: Yawgmoth overthrew the council and imprisoned all elders and Alliance delegates

events.summary: Orleason and Phoenon fall to the Alliance; Yawgmoth bombs Phoenon.
events.quote: Yawgmoth bombed the latter city, killing all the invaders and inhabitants inside

events.summary: Yawgmoth wins at Megheddon Defile and the Null Sphere, obliterating the Defile.
events.quote: finished the battle with a stonecharger that completely obliterated the Defile

events.summary: Artificers sabotage the Null Sphere and the stonechargers destroy Halcyon along with the armies.
events.quote: all of Halcyon was as well

events.summary: Halcyon survivors flee to Phyrexia and become the first Phyrexians; the empire falls.
Rebbec closes the portal before dying, locking Yawgmoth out.
events.quote: Rebbec had closed the portal to Phyrexia in the last moments before the cloud killed her

relations.quote: their one-time tormentor had seized control of the most powerful nation on the globe
thus locking Yawgmoth and his followers outside Dominaria for millennia
